About the Scholarship

IMIM is the Erasmus Mundus master in translational biomedical research run by Groningen, Heidelberg, Tartu and Uppsala. The Call '27 opens in November 2026 and the deadline is 4 January 2027, with EMJM scholarships awarded on a competitive ranking.

ApplyOfficial application page ↗

IMIM is the Erasmus Mundus master in translational biomedical research run by Groningen, Heidelberg, Tartu and Uppsala. The Call '27 opens in November 2026 and the deadline is 4 January 2027, with EMJM scholarships awarded on a competitive ranking.

Programme Highlights

  • Four top research universities with a double-degree structure
  • Bench-to-Bedside-and-Beyond innovation projects across all semesters
  • November 2026 opening and 4 January 2027 deadline
  • Industry placements in the final semester alongside Latin-America research options

Who Should Apply

Bachelor's degrees in biochemistry, biomedical sciences, pharmacy, medicine, molecular biology, biotechnology or similar, with an excellent record and research motivation; two reference forms in the IMIM format are mandatory.

Funding and Costs

EMJM scholarships for roughly 20-25 students per round from a pool of several hundred applicants: tuition plus allowances.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the IMIM site once the call opens in November 2026 and submit by 4 January 2027. Key deadline information: 4 January 2027; applications open in November 2026 for the 2027-2028 academic year.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About IMIM Consortium (University of Groningen)

The IMIM consortium is anchored at the University of Groningen with Heidelberg, Tartu and Uppsala universities, delivering the Erasmus Mundus master in Innovative Medicine focused on translational research.

Official website: https://www.innovativemedicine.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 4 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
